dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular closed-loop and semi-closed 'O' and 'C' geometries exhibit high-contrast boundaries with jagged, non-uniform perimeter transitions from low-intensity exterior to high-intensity interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of localized high-intensity pixel clusters situated along the perimeters of the annular structures; discrete, low-intensity pixel blobs are concentrated within the high-intensity interior zones of the mid-section patterns.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent lateral annular structures form an obtuse scalene triangular geometry, with the longest edge oriented along the primary longitudinal axis of the subject.
